(cite.py --check 14.9.24.4 -> OK, located by cite.py under §14.9.24.4 7) b) - the transcription attaches GR7's closing paragraph after c) to b); the text is GR7's). Code: EmitInputFile stores the as-if CLOSE's status and calls EmitTransferHook(input, ..., TransferIo.UsingClose): the USE hook runs, then EmitDisposition reads RuleFor(merge:true, UsingClose) = default cell (Terminate, Terminate, Continue, Continue) - nonfatal + USE completed normally => Continue (no jump). A USE that does NOT complete normally jumps to the statement end label (§14.9.33.4 GR2 a) 1.) - outside this rule. The unit test pins the MERGE UsingClose cell 'TTCC' against this rule. [folded GR-14.9.24.4-L2.2 = §14.9.24.4 7) c) 2.: CONFORMS]
Rule: '2. If there is no applicable USE procedure, the exception condition is ignored and the MERGE statement continues execution. The value of the data item referenced by the DEPENDING ON phrase of a RECORD IS VARYING clause specified in the file description entry for file-name-2 or file-name-3 is undefined upon completion of the MERGE statement.' (cite.py --check 14.9.24.4 -> OK, located under §14.9.24.4 7) b) - GR7's closing paragraph). Code: RuleFor(true, UsingClose).NonfatalOtherwise = Continue, so EmitDisposition emits no jump for a nonfatal CLOSE status; EmitTransferUse passes verbDisposes:true to EmitUseHook so the verb's rule, not the checking-on default of §14.6.13.1, disposes of it (the 'ignored'). The second sentence leaves the DEPENDING ON item undefined - no obligation. The unit test pins the cell.
